shared_elements: low-relief carved animals on a large upright pillar/block
schematic relief with flat raised bodies against plain ground
justification: Both surfaces show low-relief, schematic profile animals (quadrupeds, sinuous snake-like forms, and a bird-like creature) arranged in loose horizontal registers on the broad face of a large upright block, with flat raised bodies, simple outlines and no infill detail — a strong stylistic and compositional correspondence. The clearest difference is B's added elements: a row of arched/loop motifs and a fringed band with hatching near the top, plus an apparently anthropomorphic/armed figure, whereas A shows only animals scattered on an otherwise plain field.
